name: Extermination 1
detailed_description:
Welcome to Extermination 1, where fighting for survival is your only option in a world overrun by an unknown virus. 

As chaos reigns and safe havens vanish, step into the shoes of multiple characters, each with their own unique starting skills, abilities, and weapons. Battle waves of infected enemies to improve your skills and collect weapon upgrades. Forge your path to survival with permanent upgrades, enhancing your abilities after each hard-fought victory. But beware; the challenges ahead are relentless, as you are outnumbered. 

Liberate land from thousands of infected to create a chance for a better future in Extermination 1.

Features
  • Permanent Upgrades: Customize your survival strategy with permanent upgrades that persist across playthroughs, enhancing your abilities and increasing your chances of survival with each successful run.
  • Multiple Playable Characters: Choose from a diverse cast of characters, each with their own unique skills and strengths, offering a variety of gameplay experiences as you navigate the perilous world overrun by the infected.
  • Waves of Infected Enemies: Face relentless waves of infected adversaries, each more challenging than the last, putting your skills and build to the ultimate test as you strive to outlast the relentless onslaught.
  • Superweapons: Unleash the fury of superweapons, combining your top-tier arsenal into devastating weapons of mass destruction. From ingenious modifications to your most powerful firearms, create awe-inspiring tools to turn the tide of battle in your favor.

short_description: Find the most efficient way to reduce the infected population in casual rogue-lite game Extermination 1. Adapt. Overcome. There are no limits stopping you from snowballing in this reverse bullet hell.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD FX 4350 or Equivalent, Intel Core i3 6300 or Equivalent
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon™ HD 7730, NVIDIA GeForce® GT 640
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 CPU or Equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon™ R9 290, NVIDIA GeForce® GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
